title: Gemini Robotics 2: Google's AI brain for the next generation of robots | Product Hunt
excerpt: Gemini Robotics 2 is Google DeepMind’s latest step toward intelligent robots that can understand, reason, and act in the physical world. Powered by advanced Gemini models, it brings whole-body intelligence, dexterous manipulation, and adaptive reasoning to robots of different shapes and sizes. From complex physical tasks to multi-robot collaboration, Gemini Robotics 2 moves us closer to a future where robots can work alongside humans.
